name: code-lab
description: Claude Code plugins used at Code Lab.

plugins.name: self-improvement-loop
plugins.description: Promotes what each session learns into the project's agent instructions.

plugins.name: drupal-contrib
plugins.description: Local development of Drupal contrib modules and themes.

plugins.name: grilling
plugins.description: Grills the developer about a plan until both share an understanding of it.

plugins.name: drupal-security
plugins.description: Helps maintainers resolve vulnerabilities in their drupal.org contrib projects through the Drupal Security Team process.

plugins.name: ticket-worktrees
plugins.description: Runs one background Claude Code session per ticket, each in its own git worktree.

plugins.name: writing-for-agents
plugins.description: Reference for writing skills and agent instructions.

plugins.name: plan-execution
plugins.description: Executes a phased plan unattended with worker and reviewer sub-agents.
